# Angel Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results


~ Earnings to be Released, After Market Close on Tuesday, November 10th ~


~ Management will Host a Webinar to Discuss Results on Wednesday, November 11th at 8am ET ~


Provo, UT—October 14, 2026


Angel (NYSE: ANGX), a media and technology company pioneering an audience-driven model, will release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after market close on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. The Company will host a webinar on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss the results and answer questions from the sell side community. The webinar can be accessed using the dial-in numbers or registration link below.


Angel Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Webinar:


Date:


Wednesday, November 11, 2026


Time:


8:00 a.m. Eastern Time


Dial-in:


1-877-407-0779


International Dial-in:


1-201-389-0914


Webinar:


Please register[HERE](https://incommconferencing.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_Nh-HuiOrQYGb3B1CMOM6ig)


A replay will be available within 24 hours after the webinar and can be accessed here or on the Company's investor relations website at[angx.com](https://angx.com/) .


**About Angel**


Angel (NYSE: ANGX) is a media and technology company successfully pioneering a first-of-its-kind audience-driven studio model. Founded by brothers who struggled to find films they could watch with their children, Angel was built on the belief that there was a global audience hungry for values-driven storytelling that amplifies light, celebrates hope, and inspires the moral imagination of viewers. That audience became the Angel Guild, a rapidly growing community of approximately 3 million paying members who watch, screen, and vote on which films and television series get produced and distributed in theaters and on the Angel app. According to Rotten Tomatoes, Angel’s releases average among the highest audience satisfaction scores in the industry.* It has done so while evolving a new economic model that shares profits more fully with filmmakers. For more information, visit[angel.com](https://www.angel.com/) .


*www.rottentomatoes.com Popcornmeter (Data sourced October 9, 2026)
